explanation.what: supported compares the running Node with the engines range by hand, though the repository depends on semver, whose satisfies answers that.
explanation.why: The hand-written pattern reads one shape of range. Every other range semver reads is answered false.

failureScenario: package.json sets engines.node to `^22`. supported("^22", "v22.3.0") returns false, so the preinstall check refuses an install that semver's satisfies would allow.
